Incorrect: This is a reactive measure that should have been taken during the incident, not as part of the post-incident review.
questions.explanation: The post-incident review is a critical phase of the incident response process. It is an opportunity for the organization to learn from its mistakes and to make improvements to its security program to prevent similar incidents from happening in the future. The review should focus on identifying the root cause, updating plans and procedures, and understanding the full business impact of the incident.

questions.question: A company is implementing a new enterprise resource planning (ERP) system that will be used by all of its business units. The CISO is concerned that the default security settings for the ERP system are not sufficient to protect the company's sensitive data. What is the BEST approach for the CISO to take?
answers: Accept the default security settings and rely on other security controls to protect the data.
Delegate the responsibility for securing the ERP system to the vendor that is implementing it.
Work with the business units to develop a set of security requirements for the ERP system that are based on a risk assessment of the data that will be stored in it.
Insist on implementing the most stringent security controls possible, even if it makes the ERP system more difficult to use.
feedbacks: Incorrect: Accepting the default settings without a proper risk assessment is a recipe for disaster.
Incorrect: The company is ultimately responsible for the security of its own data, even if it is stored in a third-party system.

Correct: The CISO should work collaboratively with the business units to understand their needs and to develop a set of security requirements that are appropriate for the risks associated with the ERP system.
Incorrect: Security controls should be based on risk, not on a desire to be as secure as possible. Overly stringent controls can be counterproductive if they are bypassed by users.
questions.explanation: The implementation of a new ERP system is a major undertaking that has significant security implications. The CISO needs to work closely with the business units to ensure that the security of the ERP system is aligned with the needs of the business and the risks to the data. This requires a collaborative, risk-based approach that balances security with usability.

questions.question: A company's risk assessment has identified that the risk of a data breach is unacceptably high. The company has decided to mitigate the risk by implementing a data loss prevention (DLP) solution. What is the NEXT step in the risk management process?
answers: Conducting a new risk assessment to see if the DLP solution has reduced the risk to an acceptable level.
Training employees on how to use the new DLP solution.
Updating the company's security policies to reflect the use of the new DLP solution.
Reporting the results of the risk assessment to the board of directors.
feedbacks: Correct: After a risk treatment has been implemented, it is necessary to conduct a new risk assessment to determine if the residual risk is acceptable.
Incorrect: Employee training is an important part of the implementation process, but it is not the next step in the risk management process.
Incorrect: Policy updates are also part of the implementation, but they are not the next step in the risk management process.
Incorrect: The board should be kept informed of the company's risk posture, but this is not the immediate next step after implementing a risk treatment.
questions.explanation: Risk management is a continuous, cyclical process. After a risk has been treated, it is not the end of the process. The organization needs to reassess the risk to determine if the treatment was effective and if the remaining (residual) risk is at an acceptable level. This is a critical feedback loop in the risk management process.

questions.question: A company is looking to improve the security of its software development process. The CISO wants to implement a security champion program, but is facing resistance from the development teams who are concerned that it will slow them down. What is the BEST way for the CISO to get the buy-in of the development teams?
answers: By making participation in the security champion program mandatory for all developers.
By offering financial incentives to developers who become security champions.

By demonstrating how the security champion program can help developers build more secure and higher-quality software, which can actually speed up the development process in the long run by reducing rework.
By threatening to block the deployment of any software that has not been reviewed by a security champion.
feedbacks: Incorrect: Forcing developers to participate is likely to create resentment and resistance.
Incorrect: While incentives can be helpful, they are not the best way to get genuine buy-in.

Correct: The best way to get buy-in is to show the developers what's in it for them. By framing the security champion program as a way to improve their skills and the quality of their work, the CISO is more likely to get their support.
Incorrect: This is a heavy-handed approach that is likely to create an adversarial relationship between the security team and the development teams.
questions.explanation: To get buy-in for a new security initiative, it's important to understand the perspective of the people you are trying to influence. In this case, the developers are concerned about slowing down. The CISO needs to address this concern by showing them how the security champion program can actually help them be more efficient and effective in their work.

questions.question: A company has received a credible threat that a disgruntled former employee is planning to launch a cyberattack against the company's network. What is the FIRST step that the company should take?
answers: Contact law enforcement and report the threat.
Disable the former employee's user accounts and revoke their access to all corporate systems.
Conduct a forensic analysis of the former employee's computer to look for evidence of their plans.
Send a cease-and-desist letter to the former employee.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While it's important to involve law enforcement, the first priority is to protect the company's network.
Correct: The first and most important step is to cut off the former employee's access to the network to prevent them from carrying out their threat.
Incorrect: A forensic analysis is a reactive measure that should be taken after the immediate threat has been neutralized.
Incorrect: A legal letter is not going to stop a determined attacker.
questions.explanation: When faced with a credible threat from a known individual, the first priority is to take immediate action to prevent the threat from being realized. In this case, that means disabling the former employee's access to the company's network and systems. This is a critical step in containing the threat and protecting the organization.

questions.question: A company is using a variety of cloud services from different providers. The CISO is concerned about the lack of visibility and control over the company's data in the cloud. What is the BEST solution to this problem?
answers: A cloud access security broker (CASB).
A web application firewall (WAF).
A security information and event management (SIEM) system.
A data loss prevention (DLP) solution.
feedbacks: Correct: A CASB is a security solution that sits between a company's on-premises infrastructure and a cloud provider's infrastructure. It acts as a gatekeeper, allowing the organization to extend the reach of its security policies beyond its own infrastructure.
Incorrect: A WAF is designed to protect web applications from attack, but it does not provide the broad visibility and control over cloud services that a CASB does.
Incorrect: A SIEM can collect and analyze logs from cloud services, but it does not provide the real-time policy enforcement and control that a CASB does.
Incorrect: A DLP solution can help to prevent data leakage, but it does not provide the comprehensive visibility and control over cloud services that a CASB does.
questions.explanation: A cloud access security broker (CASB) is a key technology for securing the use of cloud services. It provides a single point of control for enforcing security policies across multiple cloud services, giving the organization the visibility and control it needs to protect its data in the cloud.

questions.question: A company's risk assessment has identified a number of vulnerabilities in its web application. The company has a limited budget for security and cannot fix all of the vulnerabilities at once. What is the BEST way to prioritize the remediation of these vulnerabilities?
answers: Fix the vulnerabilities that are the easiest and quickest to fix.
Fix the vulnerabilities that have been assigned the highest severity rating by the vulnerability scanner.
Fix the vulnerabilities that are most likely to be exploited by attackers, based on threat intelligence and the business impact of a successful exploit.
Fix the vulnerabilities that are required to be fixed by a specific regulation or standard.
feedbacks: Incorrect: This is not a risk-based approach and may leave the company exposed to the most serious threats.
Incorrect: The severity rating from a scanner is a good starting point, but it does not take into account the business context of the vulnerability.

Correct: The best way to prioritize vulnerabilities is to use a risk-based approach that considers both the likelihood of exploitation and the potential business impact. This ensures that the company is focusing its limited resources on the vulnerabilities that pose the greatest risk to the business.

Incorrect: While compliance is important, it should not be the only factor in prioritizing vulnerabilities. A risk-based approach will ensure that the company is addressing its most significant security risks, regardless of whether they are covered by a specific regulation.
questions.explanation: Not all vulnerabilities are created equal. Some are more likely to be exploited than others, and some have a greater potential impact on the business. Therefore, it is essential to use a risk-based approach to prioritize vulnerability remediation. This means considering both the technical severity of the vulnerability and its business context to determine which vulnerabilities pose the greatest risk to the organization.

questions.question: A company is launching a new online service for its customers. The information security program manager wants to ensure that the service is secure before it is launched. Which of the following is the BEST way to do this?
answers: By conducting a penetration test of the service just before it is launched.
By integrating security into the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC), from design to deployment.
By relying on the security of the underlying infrastructure, such as the operating system and the web server.
By purchasing a web application firewall (WAF) to protect the service from attack.
feedbacks: Incorrect: A pre-launch penetration test is a good idea, but it is not the best way to ensure the security of the service. Security should be built in from the beginning, not bolted on at the end.
Correct: The most effective way to build a secure online service is to adopt a "secure by design" approach and to integrate security activities into every phase of the SDLC.
Incorrect: While infrastructure security is important, it is not sufficient to protect the application itself. The application must be designed and coded securely.
Incorrect: A WAF is a valuable security control, but it is not a substitute for secure coding practices.
questions.explanation: The best way to build secure software is to make security a part of the entire development process. This is known as the secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) or DevSecOps. By thinking about security from the very beginning, organizations can build more resilient applications and reduce the cost of fixing security vulnerabilities later in the process.

questions.question: A company's security team has discovered that a hacker has gained access to its network and has been stealing data for several weeks. The company has contained the breach, but is unsure of the full extent of the damage. What is the MOST important lesson that can be learned from this incident?
answers: The company needs to invest more money in security tools.
The company's security team needs more training.
The company's incident detection and response capabilities are not effective enough to detect and respond to a sophisticated attack in a timely manner.
The company should have had a more restrictive firewall policy.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While new tools may be needed, the root cause of the problem is likely a failure in the incident detection and response process.
Incorrect: Training is always a good idea, but the problem is bigger than just the skills of the security team.

Correct: The fact that the attacker was able to remain on the network for several weeks without being detected is a clear indication that the company's incident detection and response program is not working as it should. The company needs to improve its ability to detect and respond to threats more quickly.
Incorrect: A restrictive firewall policy is a good practice, but it is not a silver bullet. A determined attacker can always find a way to bypass a firewall.
questions.explanation: The longer an attacker remains on a network, the more damage they can do. Therefore, the goal of any incident response program should be to reduce the mean time to detect (MTTD) and the mean time to respond (MTTR) to incidents. This requires a combination of technology, processes, and people, all working together to detect and respond to threats as quickly as possible.

questions.question: A company is outsourcing its IT infrastructure to a cloud provider. The CISO is responsible for ensuring that the company's data is protected in the cloud. Which of the following is the MOST important governance consideration in this scenario?
answers: The physical location of the cloud provider's data centers.
The cloud provider's service level agreements (SLAs) for uptime and availability.
The cloud provider's security certifications, such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
Clearly defining the roles and responsibilities for security between the company and the cloud provider in a legally binding contract.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While the location of the data centers can be important for legal and regulatory reasons, it is not the most important governance consideration.
Incorrect: SLAs are important for ensuring the availability of the service, but they are not the most important governance consideration from a security perspective.
Incorrect: While certifications are a good starting point, they are not a substitute for a thorough due diligence process.

Correct: The most important governance consideration when outsourcing to the cloud is to have a clear and comprehensive contract that defines the security responsibilities of both parties. This is essential for ensuring that there are no gaps in security coverage and that both parties understand their obligations.
questions.explanation: When a company moves to the cloud, it is entering into a partnership with the cloud provider. Like any good partnership, it needs to be based on a clear understanding of each party's roles and responsibilities. This is especially true for security, where a misunderstanding of the shared responsibility model can lead to serious security gaps. A well-written contract is the best way to ensure that both parties are on the same page when it comes to security.

questions.question: A company is concerned about the risk of phishing attacks. The company has implemented a variety of technical controls to block phishing emails, but some are still getting through to employees. What is the MOST effective additional control to mitigate the risk of phishing?
answers: Implementing a more advanced email filtering solution.
Conducting regular security awareness training and phishing simulations for all employees.
Disabling all hyperlinks in incoming emails.
Hiring a third-party firm to monitor the dark web for stolen credentials.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While a better filter might help, no filter is 100% effective.
Correct: The human element is the last line of defense against phishing. By training employees to recognize and report phishing emails, the company can significantly reduce its risk.
Incorrect: This would be a very disruptive control that would likely be met with strong resistance from employees.
Incorrect: While this is a good practice, it is a reactive measure that does not prevent phishing attacks from being successful in the first place.
questions.explanation: Phishing is a social engineering attack that targets the weakest link in the security chain: the human. Therefore, the most effective way to combat phishing is to train employees to be more security-aware. Regular training and phishing simulations can help to build a "human firewall" that can detect and report phishing attacks that bypass technical controls.

questions.question: A company has a large and complex IT environment with many different systems and applications. The information security program manager is struggling to get a clear picture of the company's overall security posture. What is the BEST solution to this problem?
answers: Hiring more security analysts to monitor the environment.
Implementing a security information and event management (SIEM) system to centralize and correlate security data from across the environment.
Conducting a one-time, comprehensive security assessment of the entire environment.
Developing a set of key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of the security program.
feedbacks: Incorrect: More analysts will not necessarily lead to a better understanding of the security posture if they do not have the right tools and processes.

Correct: A SIEM is the best tool for providing a holistic view of a company's security posture. It can collect and analyze data from a variety of sources to identify threats and trends that would be impossible to see otherwise.
Incorrect: A one-time assessment will only provide a snapshot in time. A continuous monitoring solution is needed to get a clear and up-to-date picture of the security posture.
Incorrect: KPIs are a good way to measure the performance of the security program, but they do not provide the real-time visibility that a SIEM can.
questions.explanation: In a complex IT environment, it is impossible to get a clear picture of the security posture without a centralized tool for collecting and analyzing security data. A security information and event management (SIEM) system is the best solution for this problem. It can provide the visibility and intelligence that the security team needs to detect and respond to threats in a timely manner.

questions.question: A company's security team has detected a malware infection on a critical server. The team has isolated the server from the network and is now trying to determine the best way to eradicate the malware. Which of the following is the BEST course of action?
answers: Attempt to remove the malware using an antivirus tool.
Restore the server from a known-good backup that was taken before the infection occurred.
Leave the malware on the server and monitor it to see what it does.
Pay the ransom if it is a ransomware infection.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While an antivirus tool may be able to remove some malware, it is not always effective against sophisticated threats. There is also a risk that the tool will not completely remove the malware, leaving the server vulnerable to reinfection.

Correct: The safest and most effective way to eradicate malware from a server is to wipe the server and restore it from a clean backup. This ensures that all traces of the malware are removed and that the server is returned to a known-good state.
Incorrect: This is a very risky strategy that could allow the attacker to cause further damage to the network.
Incorrect: Paying the ransom is a business decision that should not be made by the technical team. The focus of the technical team should be on eradicating the malware and restoring the system.
questions.explanation: When a critical server has been infected with malware, the top priority is to get the server back online in a secure state as quickly as possible. The most reliable way to do this is to restore the server from a known-good backup. This is much safer than trying to clean the malware from the infected server, which can be a time-consuming and error-prone process.

questions.question: A company is developing a new information security policy. The CISO wants to ensure that the policy is effective and will be followed by employees. What is the MOST important characteristic of a good security policy?
answers: It should be as long and detailed as possible to cover every possible scenario.
It should be written in a clear, concise, and easy-to-understand language.
It should be based on the security policies of other companies in the same industry.
It should be approved by the company's legal department to ensure that it is legally enforceable.
feedbacks: Incorrect: A long and complicated policy is unlikely to be read or understood by employees.
Correct: A good security policy is one that is easy for everyone in the organization to understand and follow. It should be written in plain language and should avoid technical jargon.
Incorrect: While it's a good idea to be aware of industry best practices, the security policy should be tailored to the specific needs and risks of the company.
Incorrect: While legal review is important, the most important characteristic of a good policy is that it is effective at changing employee behavior.
questions.explanation: The purpose of a security policy is to influence the behavior of employees and to create a more secure culture in the organization. To be effective, the policy must be easy for everyone to understand and follow. A policy that is written in dense, legalistic language is likely to be ignored. Therefore, the most important characteristic of a good security policy is that it is clear, concise, and easy to understand.

questions.question: A company is concerned about the risk of its employees accidentally sharing sensitive data with unauthorized individuals. The company has a data classification policy, but it is not consistently followed. What is the BEST way to improve the effectiveness of the data classification policy?
answers: By disciplining employees who fail to follow the policy.
By providing employees with more training on the data classification policy.
By implementing a data loss prevention (DLP) solution that can automatically identify and block the sharing of sensitive data based on the data classification policy.
By simplifying the data classification policy to make it easier for employees to understand.
feedbacks: Incorrect: A punitive approach is unlikely to be effective and may create a culture of fear.
Incorrect: While training is important, it is not enough to ensure that the policy is followed consistently.

Correct: The most effective way to enforce a data classification policy is to automate it with a DLP solution. This takes the burden off of employees and ensures that the policy is applied consistently.
Incorrect: While simplicity is a good goal, it will not solve the problem of inconsistent enforcement.
questions.explanation: Data classification is a foundational element of any data protection program. However, it is often difficult to get employees to follow the policy consistently. The best way to address this problem is to automate the enforcement of the policy with a data loss prevention (DDLP) solution. A DLP solution can automatically identify sensitive data and apply the appropriate controls to prevent it from being shared with unauthorized individuals.

questions.question: A company's information security program is based on the ISO 27001 standard. The company has recently achieved its ISO 27001 certification. What is the NEXT step for the information security program manager?
answers: Celebrate the achievement and move on to other projects.
Begin preparing for the next ISO 27001 audit in three years.
Continuously monitor, review, and improve the information security management system (ISMS) to maintain the certification and to ensure that it remains effective.
Reduce the budget for the security program since the company is now certified.
feedbacks: Incorrect: ISO 27001 is not a one-time achievement; it is a continuous process of improvement.
Incorrect: The company should not wait three years to start preparing for the next audit. It should be continuously monitoring and improving its security program.

Correct: ISO 27001 is based on the Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle of continuous improvement. Achieving certification is just the beginning of the journey. The company needs to continuously monitor and improve its ISMS to maintain the certification and to ensure that it remains effective at managing risk.
Incorrect: ISO 27001 certification is not an excuse to cut the security budget. In fact, it may require additional investment to maintain the certification.
questions.explanation: ISO 27001 is a management standard that requires organizations to establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve an information security management system (ISMS). Achieving certification is a significant milestone, but it is not the end of the road. The organization must be committed to a process of continuous improvement to maintain its certification and to ensure that its security program remains effective in the face of an ever-changing threat landscape.

questions.question: A company has experienced a security incident in which a hacker was able to gain access to a sensitive database by exploiting a vulnerability in a web application. The incident has been contained, and the vulnerability has been patched. What is the MOST important question that should be asked during the post-incident review?
answers: Who was the attacker?
How much did the incident cost the company?
How can we prevent this from happening again?
Who is to blame for the incident?
feedbacks: Incorrect: While attribution can be useful, it is often difficult to determine and is not the most important question to ask.
Incorrect: The cost of the incident is an important metric, but it is not the most important question to ask.

Correct: The primary purpose of a post-incident review is to learn from the incident and to take steps to prevent it from happening again. This means identifying the root cause of the incident and implementing controls to address it.
Incorrect: The purpose of a post-incident review is not to assign blame, but to identify and fix the underlying problems that led to the incident.
questions.explanation: The most important outcome of a post-incident review is a set of actionable recommendations for improving the organization's security posture. This requires a focus on identifying the root cause of the incident and on developing a plan to address it. By asking "How can we prevent this from happening again?", the organization can turn a negative event into a positive learning experience.

questions.question: A company's board of directors has approved a new information security strategy that is closely aligned with the company's business goals. What is the NEXT step in the information security governance process?
answers: To develop a set of security policies and procedures to support the strategy.
To purchase a new set of security tools to implement the strategy.
To hire a team of security professionals to execute the strategy.
To communicate the new strategy to all employees.
feedbacks: Correct: Once the strategy has been approved, the next step is to translate it into a set of actionable policies and procedures that will guide the implementation of the strategy.
Incorrect: The selection of tools should be driven by the policies and procedures, not the other way around.
Incorrect: The size and skills of the security team should be determined by the needs of the strategy, but it is not the next logical step.
Incorrect: Communication is important, but it should happen after the policies and procedures have been developed.
questions.explanation: Information security governance is a cyclical process that starts with strategy and then moves to policy, implementation, and monitoring. Once the board has approved the strategy, the next step is to develop the policies and procedures that will provide the detailed guidance for how the strategy will be implemented. This ensures that there is a clear and consistent approach to security across the organization.

questions.question: A company is conducting a risk assessment of its new e-commerce platform. The risk assessment team is using a qualitative approach to assess the risks. Which of the following is an example of a qualitative risk assessment?
answers: The risk of a data breach is estimated to be $10 million.
The likelihood of a data breach is estimated to be 25% per year.
The impact of a data breach on the company's reputation is rated as "high".
The company is required to be compliant with the PCI DSS standard.
feedbacks: Incorrect: This is an example of a quantitative risk assessment, as it assigns a monetary value to the risk.
Incorrect: This is an example of a quantitative risk assessment, as it assigns a numerical probability to the risk.
Correct: A qualitative risk assessment uses subjective ratings, such as "high," "medium," and "low," to describe the likelihood and impact of a risk.
Incorrect: This is a compliance requirement, not a risk assessment.
questions.explanation: A qualitative risk assessment is a subjective process that uses descriptive terms to evaluate the likelihood and impact of a risk. It is often used when it is difficult or impossible to assign a monetary value to a risk. While it is less precise than a quantitative risk assessment, it can still be a valuable tool for prioritizing risks and making informed decisions about how to treat them.

questions.question: A company has recently acquired a smaller company in a different country. The CISO is concerned that the acquired company's security policies are not as mature as the parent company's policies. What is the BEST approach for the CISO to take?
answers: To immediately impose the parent company's security policies on the acquired company.
To allow the acquired company to continue using its own security policies indefinitely.
To work with the management of the acquired company to conduct a risk assessment and to develop a plan for harmonizing the two companies' security policies over time.
To hire a third-party consultant to develop a new set of security policies for the combined company.
feedbacks: Incorrect: This is a heavy-handed approach that is likely to be met with resistance and may not be appropriate for the acquired company's culture and business environment.
Incorrect: This will create a security gap and will make it difficult to manage security consistently across the organization.

Correct: The best approach is a collaborative one that takes into account the specific risks and needs of the acquired company. By working together, the two companies can develop a set of security policies that are both effective and practical.
Incorrect: While a consultant can be helpful, the CISO and the management of the acquired company should be leading the process.
questions.explanation: When two companies merge, it's important to take a thoughtful and collaborative approach to integrating their security programs. Simply imposing the parent company's policies on the acquired company is not likely to be effective. A better approach is to work together to assess the risks and to develop a plan for harmonizing the policies in a way that makes sense for the combined organization.

questions.question: A company's security team has received a notification from a security researcher that there is a critical vulnerability in the company's public-facing website. The researcher has threatened to disclose the vulnerability to the public in 24 hours if the company does not pay a bug bounty. What is the FIRST thing that the company should do?
answers: Pay the bug bounty to prevent the vulnerability from being disclosed.
Ignore the researcher's email and hope that they are bluffing.
Acknowledge the researcher's email and ask for more details about the vulnerability so that it can be validated and fixed.
Contact law enforcement and report the researcher for extortion.
feedbacks: Incorrect: Paying the bounty without first validating the vulnerability is a bad idea.
Incorrect: This is a very risky strategy that could lead to a public relations disaster.

Correct: The first step is to engage with the researcher in a professional and constructive manner. By acknowledging their email and asking for more information, the company can buy itself some time to validate the vulnerability and to develop a plan for fixing it.
Incorrect: While the researcher's threat may be unprofessional, it is not necessarily illegal. The company should focus on fixing the vulnerability, not on punishing the researcher.
questions.explanation: When a company is notified of a vulnerability by a security researcher, the best course of action is to respond in a timely and professional manner. The company should thank the researcher for their finding and ask for the information it needs to validate and fix the vulnerability. This is the best way to build a positive relationship with the security research community and to protect the company from a public disclosure.

questions.question: A company is developing a new information security governance framework. The CISO wants to ensure that the framework is aligned with industry best practices. Which of the following is the MOST widely recognized and respected framework for information security governance?
answers: ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library).
COSO (Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission).
COBIT (Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies).
NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
feedbacks: Incorrect: ITIL is a framework for IT service management, not information security governance.
Incorrect: COSO is a framework for enterprise risk management, but it is not specifically focused on information security.

Correct: COBIT is a comprehensive framework for the governance and management of enterprise IT. It provides a set of principles, practices, and analytical tools to help organizations align their IT with their business goals and to manage their IT-related risks.

Incorrect: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework is a valuable resource for improving cybersecurity risk management, but it is not as comprehensive as COBIT when it comes to the overall governance of information security.
questions.explanation: COBIT is the de facto standard for information security governance. It is a comprehensive and globally recognized framework that provides a holistic approach to the governance and management of enterprise IT. By aligning with COBIT, organizations can ensure that their information security governance framework is based on industry best practices and is well-suited to meet the needs of the business.

questions.question: A company is conducting a risk assessment of its third-party vendors. The company has a large number of vendors, and it is not practical to conduct a full security assessment of each one. What is the BEST way to prioritize the vendors for assessment?
answers: Prioritize the vendors that are the most expensive.
Prioritize the vendors that have been with the company the longest.
Prioritize the vendors that have the most access to the company's sensitive data and systems.
Prioritize the vendors that are located in foreign countries.
feedbacks: Incorrect: The cost of a vendor is not necessarily an indicator of the risk they pose to the company.
Incorrect: The length of a vendor relationship is not a good indicator of their security posture.

Correct: The vendors that pose the greatest risk to the company are the ones that have the most access to its most valuable assets. These are the vendors that should be prioritized for security assessment.
Incorrect: While there may be additional risks associated with foreign vendors, this is not the best way to prioritize them for assessment.
questions.explanation: When it comes to third-party risk management, not all vendors are created equal. The key to an effective program is to focus on the vendors that pose the greatest risk to the organization. This means identifying the vendors that have access to the most sensitive data and systems and prioritizing them for security assessment and ongoing monitoring.

questions.question: A company is looking to improve its security culture. The CISO has implemented a security awareness training program, but is not seeing a significant change in employee behavior. What is the BEST way to improve the effectiveness of the security awareness program?
answers: By making the training longer and more detailed.
By making the training mandatory for all employees and by testing them on the material.
By making the training more engaging and relevant to the employees' jobs, and by reinforcing the training with ongoing communication and phishing simulations.
By punishing employees who fail to follow the security policies.
feedbacks: Incorrect: Longer training is not necessarily better. In fact, it can be counterproductive if it is boring and not engaging.
Incorrect: While mandatory training and testing can be helpful, they are not enough to change the security culture.

Correct: The best way to change employee behavior is to make security training a positive and ongoing experience. The training should be engaging, relevant, and reinforced with regular communication and practical exercises.
Incorrect: A punitive approach is likely to create a culture of fear and resentment, which is the opposite of a good security culture.
questions.explanation: A good security culture is not built on fear or compliance; it is built on a shared understanding of the importance of security and a commitment to doing the right thing. To build this kind of culture, security awareness training needs to be more than just a box-ticking exercise. It needs to be an ongoing program that is engaging, relevant, and reinforced with regular communication and practical exercises.

questions.question: A company has experienced a data breach in which an attacker was able to steal a large amount of customer data. The company has contained the breach and is now in the process of notifying the affected customers. What is the MOST important thing to include in the customer notification?
answers: A detailed technical explanation of how the breach occurred.
A promise that the company will never have another data breach.
A clear and concise explanation of what happened, what data was stolen, and what the company is doing to protect the customers from further harm.
A coupon for a discount on the company's products or services.
feedbacks: Incorrect: Most customers will not be interested in the technical details of the breach.
Incorrect: This is an unrealistic promise that the company cannot keep.

Correct: The customer notification should be clear, concise, and helpful. It should provide the customers with the information they need to protect themselves and to understand what the company is doing to address the situation.
Incorrect: While a coupon may be a nice gesture, it is not a substitute for a clear and honest explanation of what happened.
questions.explanation: When a company has a data breach, it is important to communicate with the affected customers in a clear, concise, and transparent manner. The notification should explain what happened, what data was involved, and what the company is doing to help the customers protect themselves. This is the best way to maintain the trust of the customers and to minimize the reputational damage from the breach.

questions.question: A company's CISO is developing a business case for a new security investment. The CISO wants to use a quantitative approach to justify the investment to the board of directors. Which of the following is the BEST metric to use in a quantitative business case?
answers: The number of security incidents that the investment is expected to prevent.
The return on security investment (ROSI).
The percentage of systems that will be compliant with the company's security policies after the investment is made.
The number of hours that the security team will save as a result of the investment.
feedbacks: Incorrect: This is a good metric, but it is not the best one for a quantitative business case.

Correct: ROSI is a quantitative metric that compares the cost of a security investment to the expected financial benefit from the investment. It is the best way to demonstrate the value of a security investment to the board of directors.
Incorrect: This is a compliance metric, not a financial metric.
Incorrect: This is an efficiency metric, not a financial metric.
questions.explanation: When making a business case for a security investment, it is important to speak the language of the business. The board of directors is interested in the financial return on investment, so the CISO should use a metric that clearly demonstrates the financial benefit of the investment. Return on security investment (ROSI) is the best metric for this purpose, as it directly compares the cost of the investment to the expected financial return.

questions.question: A company is concerned about the risk of a denial-of-service (DoS) attack against its e-commerce website. The company has a limited budget for security and cannot afford a dedicated DoS mitigation service. What is the MOST cost-effective way to mitigate the risk of a DoS attack?
answers: By implementing a rate-limiting feature on the web server to limit the number of requests from a single IP address.
By purchasing a larger and more powerful web server that can handle a higher volume of traffic.
By blocking all traffic from known malicious IP addresses.
By asking the company's internet service provider (ISP) to block the malicious traffic.
feedbacks: Correct: Rate limiting is a simple and cost-effective way to mitigate the risk of a simple DoS attack. It can be implemented on most web servers and does not require any additional hardware or software.
Incorrect: This is not a cost-effective solution, as it does not address the root cause of the problem.
Incorrect: This is a reactive measure that is not very effective against a distributed DoS attack, which uses a large number of different IP addresses.
Incorrect: Most ISPs will not provide this service for free, and it can be expensive.
questions.explanation: For a company with a limited budget, the most cost-effective way to mitigate the risk of a simple denial-of-service (DoS) attack is to implement rate limiting on the web server. This is a simple and effective control that can be implemented at little to no cost. While it will not protect against a large-scale distributed DoS (DDoS) attack, it can be a valuable first line of defense.

questions.question: A company is developing a new security awareness training program. The CISO wants to make sure that the program is effective at changing employee behavior. Which of the following is the BEST way to measure the effectiveness of the program?
answers: By surveying employees to see if they enjoyed the training.
By testing employees on the material that was covered in the training.
By conducting regular phishing simulations to see if employees are less likely to fall for a phishing attack after the training.
By tracking the number of security incidents that are caused by human error.
feedbacks: Incorrect: Employee satisfaction is not a good measure of the effectiveness of the training.
Incorrect: A test can measure knowledge, but it cannot measure behavior.

Correct: The best way to measure the effectiveness of security awareness training is to see if it actually changes employee behavior. A phishing simulation is a great way to do this, as it provides a real-world test of the employees' ability to recognize and report a phishing attack.
Incorrect: While this is a good metric, it is a lagging indicator. A phishing simulation is a leading indicator that can provide more timely feedback on the effectiveness of the training.
questions.explanation: The goal of security awareness training is to change behavior, not just to impart knowledge. Therefore, the best way to measure the effectiveness of the training is to use a metric that directly measures behavior. A phishing simulation is the perfect tool for this, as it allows the organization to see if employees are actually applying what they have learned in the training.

questions.question: A company has experienced a security incident in which an employee's laptop was stolen from their car. The laptop contained sensitive customer data that was not encrypted. What is the MOST important lesson that can be learned from this incident?
answers: The company needs to have a stronger physical security policy for its offices.
The company needs to provide its employees with more security awareness training.
The company needs to have a policy that requires all laptops to be encrypted.
The company needs to have a better incident response plan.
feedbacks: Incorrect: The laptop was stolen from the employee's car, not from the office.
Incorrect: While training is important, it is not the most important lesson to be learned from this incident.

Correct: The root cause of this data breach was the fact that the data on the laptop was not encrypted. If the data had been encrypted, the theft of the laptop would not have resulted in a data breach.
Incorrect: While a good incident response plan is important, it would not have prevented this data breach from occurring.
questions.explanation: This incident highlights the importance of data encryption. In today's mobile world, it is inevitable that some laptops will be lost or stolen. The best way to protect the data on those laptops is to encrypt it. Encryption is a fundamental security control that should be implemented on all laptops that contain sensitive data.

questions.question: A company is developing a new information security strategy. The CISO wants to ensure that the strategy is comprehensive and covers all of the key areas of information security. Which THREE of the following should be included in the strategy?
answers: A plan for achieving and maintaining compliance with all relevant security regulations and standards.
A list of all the security tools and technologies that the company plans to purchase.
A roadmap for how the company will mature its security capabilities over time.
The results of the company's most recent penetration test.
A high-level overview of the company's security governance framework, including the roles and responsibilities of the various stakeholders.
feedbacks: Correct: Compliance is a key driver for information security, and the strategy should address all of the company's compliance obligations.
Incorrect: The strategy should be technology-agnostic. The selection of specific tools should be a tactical decision that is made after the strategy has been developed.
Correct: A good security strategy is a long-term plan that outlines how the company will improve its security posture over time.
Incorrect: A penetration test is a snapshot in time and is not a strategic document.
Correct: The security strategy should be grounded in a strong governance framework that defines the roles and responsibilities for security across the organization.
questions.explanation: A comprehensive information security strategy should address the key pillars of a mature security program: governance, risk management, and compliance. It should be a long-term, risk-based plan that is aligned with the needs of the business and that provides a roadmap for continuous improvement.

questions.question: A company is conducting a risk assessment of its new mobile application. The risk assessment team has identified a number of risks and has assigned a risk score to each one based on its likelihood and impact. What is the NEXT step in the risk management process?
answers: To develop a risk treatment plan for each of the identified risks.
To report the results of the risk assessment to the board of directors.
To conduct a new risk assessment to see if there are any other risks that were missed.
To purchase a cybersecurity insurance policy to cover the risks.
feedbacks: Correct: Once the risks have been assessed and prioritized, the next step is to develop a plan for how to treat them. This could involve mitigating the risk, transferring it, accepting it, or avoiding it.
Incorrect: The board should be informed of the company's risk posture, but this is not the immediate next step after the risk assessment.
Incorrect: The risk assessment process should be iterative, but the next step is to address the risks that have already been identified.
Incorrect: Insurance is a form of risk transference, which is one of the options for risk treatment. It should not be the default response to all risks.
questions.explanation: Risk management is a structured process that involves identifying, assessing, and treating risks. Once the risks have been assessed and prioritized, the next logical step is to develop a plan for how to respond to them. This is known as the risk treatment plan, and it is a critical component of any risk management program.

questions.question: A company's information security program has been in place for several years, but it has not been well-documented. The CISO wants to create a set of formal security policies and procedures to provide a foundation for the program. What is the BEST source of information for developing these policies and procedures?
answers: The security policies of other companies in the same industry.
The recommendations of the company's security vendors.
A combination of industry best practices (such as ISO 27001 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework) and the company's own risk assessment.
A survey of the company's employees to see what they think the security policies should be.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While it can be helpful to see what other companies are doing, the policies should be tailored to the specific needs and risks of the company.
Incorrect: Vendors are a good source of information about their own products, but they are not an objective source of information about security policies.

Correct: The best security policies are based on a combination of established best practices and a thorough understanding of the company's own unique risks. This ensures that the policies are both effective and practical.
Incorrect: While it's important to get input from employees, they are not the best source of information for developing security policies.
questions.explanation: The development of security policies should be a thoughtful and deliberate process that is based on a solid foundation of risk management and industry best practices. By combining the guidance of established frameworks like ISO 27001 and NIST with the results of a company-specific risk assessment, the CISO can create a set of policies that are both effective and tailored to the needs of the business.

questions.question: A company has experienced a major security incident in which a hacker was able to gain access to the company's network and steal a large amount of sensitive data. The company has contained the breach and is now in the process of recovering from the incident. Which of the following is the MOST important goal of the recovery phase?
answers: To restore the affected systems and data from backups as quickly as possible.
To identify the attacker and to bring them to justice.
To determine the full cost of the incident.
To communicate with the affected customers and to offer them credit monitoring services.
feedbacks: Correct: The primary goal of the recovery phase is to get the business back to normal operations as quickly and as safely as possible. This means restoring the affected systems and data from clean backups.
Incorrect: While attribution is important, it is not the primary goal of the recovery phase.
Incorrect: Calculating the cost of the incident is an important part of the post-incident review, but it is not the primary goal of the recovery phase.
Incorrect: Customer communication is an important part of the incident response process, but it is not the primary goal of the recovery phase.
questions.explanation: The recovery phase of the incident response process is all about getting the business back on its feet after a security incident. The top priority is to restore the affected systems and data from known-good backups so that the business can resume its normal operations. This needs to be done in a careful and deliberate manner to ensure that the systems are not reinfected.

questions.question: A company is looking to adopt a more risk-based approach to information security governance. The CISO wants to establish a risk management framework that will be used to identify, assess, and treat security risks across the organization. Which of the following is the BEST first step in establishing a risk management framework?
answers: To purchase a risk management software tool.
To define the company's risk appetite and tolerance.
To conduct a risk assessment of all of the company's IT systems.
To hire a team of risk management professionals.
feedbacks: Incorrect: A tool can be helpful, but it is not the first step. The first step is to define the framework itself.

Correct: The first step in establishing a risk management framework is to define the organization's risk appetite, which is the amount of risk that the organization is willing to accept in pursuit of its business objectives. This will provide the foundation for all other risk management activities.
Incorrect: A risk assessment should be conducted within the context of the risk management framework, not before it has been established.
Incorrect: The size and skills of the risk management team should be determined by the needs of the framework, but it is not the first step in establishing it.
questions.explanation: A risk management framework must be tailored to the specific needs and context of the organization. The first and most important step in developing the framework is to define the organization's risk appetite and tolerance. This will provide the necessary guidance for making risk-based decisions and for ensuring that the risk management program is aligned with the goals of the business.

questions.question: A company is concerned about the risk of its employees falling victim to social engineering attacks. The company has implemented a security awareness training program, but the CISO is not confident that it is effective. What is the BEST way to test the effectiveness of the training program?
answers: By surveying employees to see if they feel more prepared to deal with social engineering attacks.
By tracking the number of reported social engineering attempts.
By conducting a social engineering penetration test, in which a third-party firm attempts to trick employees into divulging sensitive information.
By reviewing the logs of the company's email filter to see how many social engineering emails are being blocked.
feedbacks: Incorrect: A survey can measure perception, but it cannot measure actual behavior.
Incorrect: This is a good metric, but it does not tell you how many unreported attempts were successful.

Correct: The best way to test the effectiveness of a social engineering training program is to see if it actually works in a real-world scenario. A social engineering penetration test can provide a realistic assessment of the company's vulnerability to this type of attack.
Incorrect: This is a good way to measure the effectiveness of the email filter, but it does not measure the effectiveness of the training program.
questions.explanation: The only way to know for sure if a security awareness training program is effective is to test it. A social engineering penetration test is the most realistic way to do this. By simulating a real-world social engineering attack, the organization can get a clear picture of how well its employees are able to recognize and resist this type of threat.

questions.question: A company is developing a new information security program. The CISO wants to ensure that the program is comprehensive and covers all of the key elements of a mature security program. Which of the following is the MOST appropriate framework to use as a model for the program?
answers: ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library).
COSO (Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission).
The NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard).
feedbacks: Incorrect: ITIL is a framework for IT service management, not information security.
Incorrect: COSO is a framework for enterprise risk management, but it is not specifically focused on information security.

Correct: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework is a voluntary framework that consists of standards, guidelines, and best practices to manage cybersecurity-related risk. It is a comprehensive and widely adopted framework that can be used to build a mature and effective security program.
Incorrect: PCI DSS is a very specific standard that is only applicable to organizations that handle credit card data. It is not a general framework for information security.
questions.explanation: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework is an excellent resource for any organization that is looking to build or improve its information security program. It is a comprehensive, risk-based framework that is aligned with industry best practices. By using the NIST framework as a model, the CISO can ensure that the company's security program is well-designed and covers all of the key areas of a mature program.

questions.question: A company has experienced a security incident in which an employee's unencrypted laptop was lost. The laptop contained the personal information of thousands of customers. The company is now facing a class-action lawsuit from the affected customers. What is the MOST important lesson that can be learned from this incident from an incident management perspective?
answers: The company needs to have a better process for tracking its IT assets.
The company needs to have a stronger policy on the use of personal devices for work.
The company needs to have a more mature incident response process that includes a plan for dealing with the legal and public relations fallout from a data breach.
The company needs to have more cybersecurity insurance.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While asset tracking is important, it is not the most important lesson to be learned from this incident.
Incorrect: The laptop was a company-owned device, not a personal device.

Correct: This incident highlights the fact that incident response is not just a technical process; it is also a business process. A mature incident response plan should address the legal, financial, and reputational consequences of a security incident.
Incorrect: Insurance can help to offset the financial losses from a data breach, but it is not a substitute for a good incident response plan.
questions.explanation: A major data breach is a business crisis, not just a technical problem. The incident response plan needs to reflect this reality. It should include procedures for communicating with customers, dealing with the media, and managing the legal and regulatory consequences of the breach. By taking a holistic approach to incident response, the organization can minimize the damage from a security incident and protect its reputation.

questions.question: A company's CISO is presenting the annual information security budget to the board of directors. The CISO wants to get the board's approval for a significant increase in the budget. What is the BEST way for the CISO to justify the budget increase?
answers: By showing the board a list of all the new security tools that the company needs to buy.
By comparing the company's security budget to the budgets of its competitors.

By presenting a risk-based business case that shows how the increased investment will reduce the company's risk of a major security breach and the potential financial losses that would result from such a breach.
By telling the board that the company will not be able to achieve its business goals without the increased security investment.
feedbacks: Incorrect: The board is not interested in a shopping list of security tools. They want to understand the business case for the investment.
Incorrect: A budget comparison is not a good way to justify a budget increase, as it does not take into account the specific risks and needs of the company.

Correct: The best way to justify a security budget is to speak the language of the business. The CISO should present a clear and compelling business case that shows how the investment will reduce the company's risk and protect its bottom line.
Incorrect: This is a fear-based argument that is not likely to be effective with a sophisticated board of directors.
questions.explanation: The board of directors is responsible for overseeing the financial health of the company. Therefore, any request for a budget increase must be justified in financial terms. The CISO should present a risk-based business case that clearly articulates the potential financial impact of a security breach and shows how the proposed investment will reduce that risk. This is the most effective way to get the board's buy-in and to secure the resources that are needed to protect the company.

questions.question: A company is conducting a risk assessment of its new cloud-based CRM system. The risk assessment team has identified a number of risks, including the risk of a data breach, the risk of a service outage, and the risk of non-compliance with data privacy regulations. What is the BEST way to treat these risks?
answers: To accept all of the risks, as they are an inherent part of using a cloud service.
To transfer all of the risks to the cloud provider by signing a contract that makes them responsible for all security incidents.
To avoid all of the risks by not using the cloud CRM system.
To use a combination of risk mitigation, transference, and acceptance, depending on the specific risk and the company's risk appetite.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While some risk is inherent in using the cloud, it is not acceptable to simply accept all risks without any mitigation.
Incorrect: It is not possible to transfer all risks to the cloud provider. The company is still ultimately responsible for its own data.
Incorrect: The company has already decided to use the CRM system, so avoiding the risk is not an option.

Correct: The best way to treat a variety of risks is to use a variety of risk treatment options. The specific option that is chosen for each risk will depend on the nature of the risk and the company's willingness to accept it.
questions.explanation: There is no one-size-fits-all approach to risk treatment. The best approach is to use a combination of different risk treatment options, depending on the specific circumstances. For some risks, mitigation will be the best option. For others, transference or acceptance may be more appropriate. The key is to make a conscious and informed decision about how to treat each risk, based on a thorough understanding of the risk and the company's risk appetite.

questions.question: A company is developing a new information security program. The CISO wants to ensure that the program is supported by a strong security culture. Which of the following is the MOST important element of a strong security culture?
answers: A comprehensive set of security policies and procedures.
A state-of-the-art security awareness training program.
The visible and consistent support of senior management for the security program.
A team of highly skilled and dedicated security professionals.
feedbacks: Incorrect: Policies and procedures are important, but they are not the most important element of a strong security culture.
Incorrect: Training is important, but it is not the most important element of a strong security culture.

Correct: The most important element of a strong security culture is the "tone at the top." When senior management demonstrates a strong commitment to security, it sends a clear message to the rest of the organization that security is a top priority.
Incorrect: A good security team is important, but it cannot create a strong security culture on its own.
questions.explanation: A strong security culture is one in which everyone in the organization understands their role in protecting the company's information assets and is committed to doing their part. This kind of culture does not happen by accident; it has to be deliberately cultivated from the top down. When senior leaders make security a priority and lead by example, they create a ripple effect that can transform the entire organization.

questions.question: A company has experienced a security incident in which an attacker was able to gain access to the company's network by guessing a user's weak password. The incident has been contained, and the user's password has been reset. What is the MOST important corrective action that the company should take to prevent this from happening again?
answers: To provide the user with additional security awareness training on how to create strong passwords.
To implement a more stringent password policy that requires users to create longer and more complex passwords.
To implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all users.
To monitor the user's account for any suspicious activity.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While training is a good idea, it is not the most important corrective action.
Incorrect: A more stringent password policy can be helpful, but it is not the most important corrective action.

Correct: MFA is the single most effective control for preventing unauthorized access to accounts due to weak or stolen passwords. By requiring users to provide a second factor of authentication, such as a code from their smartphone, the company can make it much more difficult for an attacker to gain access to an account, even if they have the user's password.
Incorrect: Monitoring is a detective control, not a preventive control.
questions.explanation: Weak passwords are a major cause of security breaches. The best way to mitigate this risk is to implement multi-factor authentication (MFA). MFA adds an extra layer of security that makes it much more difficult for an attacker to gain access to an account, even if they have the user's password. It is one of the most effective security controls that an organization can implement.

questions.question: A company is using a number of different cloud services, including IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS. The CISO is concerned about the security of the company's data in the cloud. Which of the following is the MOST important security consideration in a multi-cloud environment?
answers: The cost of the various cloud services.
The performance of the various cloud services.
The need for a consistent and centralized approach to security governance and management across all of the cloud services.
The ease of use of the various cloud services.
feedbacks: Incorrect: Cost is a business consideration, not a security consideration.
Incorrect: Performance is an operational consideration, not a security consideration.

Correct: In a multi-cloud environment, it is essential to have a unified security strategy that can be applied consistently across all of the different cloud services. This requires a strong governance framework and a centralized management platform.
Incorrect: Ease of use is a usability consideration, not a security consideration.
questions.explanation: A multi-cloud environment can be complex and difficult to secure. The key to success is to have a centralized and consistent approach to security governance and management. This means having a single set of security policies that are applied to all of the cloud services, and a single platform for monitoring and managing security across the entire environment. This is the only way to ensure that there are no gaps in security and that the company's data is protected, no matter where it resides.

questions.question: A company is conducting a risk assessment of its new website. The risk assessment team has identified a vulnerability that could allow an attacker to perform a cross-site scripting (XSS) attack. The team is not sure how to assess the risk of this vulnerability. What is the BEST source of information for assessing the risk of a common web application vulnerability like XSS?
answers: The company's own historical data on security incidents.
The recommendations of the company's web hosting provider.
A publicly available vulnerability ranking system, such as the OWASP Top 10.
A survey of the company's customers to see if they are concerned about XSS attacks.
feedbacks: Incorrect: The company may not have any historical data on XSS attacks, especially if this is a new website.
Incorrect: The web hosting provider may not have the expertise to assess the risk of a specific web application vulnerability.

Correct: The OWASP Top 10 is a widely recognized and respected list of the most critical web application security risks. It can be a valuable resource for assessing the risk of common vulnerabilities like XSS.
Incorrect: Customers are not likely to be aware of the technical details of web application vulnerabilities.
questions.explanation: The OWASP Top 10 is an invaluable resource for any organization that is developing or operating a web application. It provides a prioritized list of the most common and most critical web application security risks, along with guidance on how to mitigate them. By using the OWASP Top 10 as a guide, the risk assessment team can quickly and easily assess the risk of common vulnerabilities like cross-site scripting (XSS).

questions.question: A company is developing a new security awareness training program. The CISO wants to make the program as effective as possible. Which THREE of the following are key elements of an effective security awareness program?
answers: The program should be mandatory for all employees, and there should be consequences for not completing it.
The program should be tailored to the specific roles and responsibilities of the employees.
The program should be delivered in a variety of formats, such as online courses, videos, and live presentations, to keep employees engaged.
The program should be a one-time event that is held annually.
The program should include a way to measure its effectiveness, such as by conducting regular phishing simulations.
feedbacks: Incorrect: While making the program mandatory can be helpful, it is not one of the three most important elements of an effective program.
Correct: A one-size-fits-all approach to security awareness training is not effective. The training should be tailored to the specific risks that employees face in their day-to-day jobs.
Correct: People learn in different ways, so it's important to use a variety of training methods to keep the material fresh and engaging.
Incorrect: Security awareness is not a one-time event; it is an ongoing process. The training should be reinforced with regular communication and phishing simulations.
Correct: The only way to know if a security awareness program is effective is to measure its impact on employee behavior. Phishing simulations are a great way to do this.
questions.explanation: An effective security awareness program is one that is tailored, engaging, and measurable. By customizing the training to the specific needs of the employees, using a variety of delivery methods, and measuring the results, the CISO can create a program that has a real and lasting impact on the company's security culture.

questions.question: A company has experienced a security incident in which a hacker was able to gain access to the company's network by exploiting a vulnerability in a third-party software product. The incident has been contained, and the vulnerability has been patched. What is the MOST important lesson that can be learned from this incident?
answers: The company needs to have a better process for managing its third-party vendors.
The company needs to have a better process for patching its own systems.
The company needs to have a better intrusion detection system (IDS).
The company needs to have more cybersecurity insurance.
feedbacks: Correct: This incident highlights the importance of having a robust third-party risk management program. The company needs to have a process for assessing the security of its vendors and for ensuring that they are patching their products in a timely manner.
Incorrect: The vulnerability was in a third-party product, not in the company's own systems.
Incorrect: While an IDS might have detected the attack sooner, it would not have prevented it from happening.
Incorrect: Insurance can help to offset the financial losses from a data breach, but it is not a substitute for a good third-party risk management program.
questions.explanation: Third-party risk is a major and growing concern for all organizations. This incident is a classic example of a supply chain attack, in which an attacker compromises a trusted vendor to gain access to their customers. The best way to mitigate this risk is to have a comprehensive third-party risk management program that includes security assessments, contractual requirements, and ongoing monitoring.

questions.question: A company is developing a new cloud-first strategy. The CISO wants to ensure that the company's information security governance framework is adapted to the new cloud environment. Which of the following is the MOST important change that needs to be made to the governance framework?
answers: The framework should be rewritten to focus on the security of the company's on-premises data center.

The framework should be updated to address the new risks and opportunities that are associated with the cloud, such as the shared responsibility model, data residency, and the use of new technologies like serverless computing and containers.
The framework should be simplified to make it easier for the company to move to the cloud quickly.
The framework should be made more restrictive to compensate for the perceived lack of security in the cloud.
feedbacks: Incorrect: In a cloud-first strategy, the focus should be on the security of the cloud environment, not the on-premises data center.

Correct: A cloud-first strategy introduces a whole new set of security challenges and opportunities. The governance framework needs to be updated to reflect this new reality. It should address the unique risks of the cloud, such as the shared responsibility model and data residency, and it should also take advantage of the new security capabilities that are available in the cloud.
Incorrect: While simplicity is a good goal, it should not come at the expense of security. The governance framework should be comprehensive enough to address the risks of the cloud.

Incorrect: The framework should be based on a risk assessment of the cloud environment, not on a perception of insecurity. A restrictive framework could stifle innovation and prevent the company from taking full advantage of the benefits of the cloud.
questions.explanation: Moving to the cloud is a major strategic shift that has significant implications for information security. The company's governance framework needs to be updated to reflect this new reality. It needs to address the new risks that are associated with the cloud, such as the shared responsibility model, and it needs to provide a framework for managing security in a consistent and effective way across the entire multi-cloud environment.

questions.question: A company is conducting a risk assessment of its new website. The risk assessment team has identified a number of vulnerabilities and has assessed the risk of each one. The team is now trying to decide which risks to treat and which to accept. What is the BEST basis for this decision?
answers: The cost of treating the risk.
The company's risk appetite.
The recommendations of the risk assessment team.
The requirements of the company's cybersecurity insurance policy.
feedbacks: Incorrect: Cost is a factor, but it is not the only factor.

Correct: The decision of whether to treat or accept a risk should be based on the company's risk appetite, which is the amount of risk that the company is willing to accept in pursuit of its business objectives. If the risk is above the company's risk appetite, then it should be treated. If it is below the risk appetite, then it can be accepted.
Incorrect: The risk assessment team can make recommendations, but the final decision should be made by the business, based on the company's risk appetite.
Incorrect: The insurance policy may have some requirements, but it should not be the sole basis for the decision.
questions.explanation: The concept of risk appetite is a fundamental principle of risk management. It is the amount of risk that an organization is willing to take on in order to achieve its business goals. The risk appetite should be defined by the board of directors and senior management, and it should be used to guide all risk-based decisions, including the decision of which risks to treat and which to accept.

questions.question: A company has a very limited budget for information security. The CISO wants to make the most of the available resources. What is the BEST way to do this?
answers: By focusing on compliance with all relevant security regulations and standards.
By investing in the latest and most advanced security technologies.
By taking a risk-based approach to security, which involves identifying the company's most critical assets and focusing the available resources on protecting them.
By outsourcing the entire security program to a managed security service provider (MSSP).
feedbacks: Incorrect: Compliance is a baseline, not a strategy. A risk-based approach is a more effective way to use limited resources.
Incorrect: Technology is not a silver bullet. A risk-based approach will ensure that the company is investing in the right technologies.

Correct: A risk-based approach is the most effective way to use a limited security budget. By focusing on the risks that pose the greatest threat to the business, the CISO can ensure that the company is getting the most bang for its buck.
Incorrect: Outsourcing can be a good option for some companies, but it is not a magic bullet. The company is still ultimately responsible for its own security.
questions.explanation: When resources are limited, it's more important than ever to take a risk-based approach to security. This means identifying the crown jewels of the organization and focusing the available resources on protecting them.
